svg.title: Procurement and goods receiving
svg.desc: Procurement and goods receiving. Which requisition and PO line support a received quantity? Primary tables: Supplier, PurchaseRequisition, PurchaseOrder, PurchaseOrderLine, GoodsReceipt, GoodsReceiptLine. Use PurchaseOrderLine.RequisitionID for a batched order. A stored receipt/invoice relationship does not prove a system-enforced matching control.
